bar.readOnlyHint: Only the owner or a workspace-wide manager can change these settings.

delivery.title: Delivery status
delivery.switchHint: When off, the workspace stops sending email through this sender

replyTo.label: Reply-to address
replyTo.hint: Optional. Leave blank to use the from address.

senderDomain.label: Sender domain
senderDomain.hint: The domain you send from. Changing it clears verification.

providerDriver.label: Delivery provider
providerDriver.hint: SMTP uses your own mail server. The shared provider needs no setup.

smtpHost.label: Host
smtpHost.hint: The mail server name, for example smtp.example.com.

smtpPort.label: Port
smtpPort.hint: 25, 465, 587 or 2525. Port 587 with encryption is usual.

smtpUsername.label: Username
smtpUsername.hint: The login for the mail server.

smtpProtocol.label: Protocol
smtpProtocol.hint: SMTPS encrypts from the start and requires encryption.

smtpSecure.label: Encrypted connection
smtpSecure.hint: Connects with TLS. Required for SMTPS.

dkimHost.label: DKIM record name
dkimHost.hint: Publish your DKIM record at this DNS name.

dailyQuota.label: Daily limit
dailyQuota.hint: Emails per day, up to your plan limit.

rateLimitPerMin.label: Per-minute limit
rateLimitPerMin.hint: Emails per minute, up to your plan limit.

notice.resetsVerification: Saving clears the domain verification and pauses sending until you verify again.

smtp.testNeedsSave: Save your changes first. The test uses saved settings.

probe.note: Checks that the server is reachable and the login works. No email is sent.

dns.valueNote: The expected record value is not shown here. If the domain does not verify, contact support.

conflict.same: Your changes match the saved values.

suppression.title: Email suppressions

address.label: Email address
address.hint: Used only for this check and never stored in the browser.

suppression.blocked: This workspace blocks delivery to this address.
suppression.clear: No workspace block found for this address.

lift.title: Lift the block for this address?
lift.text: Lifts this workspace's block. Previous emails are not resent.
lift.none: No block was active for this address.

errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a minute.

states.failedTitle: Could not load the email settings
states.blockedTitle: Email access is blocked by your access policy
states.notEntitledTitle: Email is not in your plan

errors.idemMismatch: This change no longer matches the earlier attempt. Save again.
errors.domainMismatch: The from address must use the sender domain.
errors.domain: Enter a valid domain, for example example.com.
errors.limitRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
errors.TENANT_EMAIL_CONFIG_INVALID: These settings are not valid. Check the values and try again.
errors.TENANT_EMAIL_CONFIG_QUOTA_EXCEEDS_PLAN: The limit cannot exceed your plan limit.
errors.TENANT_EMAIL_CONFIG_VERIFICATION_FAILED: DNS verification for the sender domain did not pass.
errors.TENANT_EMAIL_CONFIG_DKIM_PROOF_NOT_REGIS: No DKIM record is registered for this domain and selector. Contact your administrator.
errors.TENANT_SMTP_CONNECTION_FAILED: Could not connect to the SMTP server. Check the host, port and login.
errors.TENANT_EMAIL_CONFIG_DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILAB: The email service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
